Error: Section "nope" is not in any guide under "tokens". Open one of its guides instead.

  tokens/tokens-color  (Semantic colors for consistent theming. All colors use light-dark() for automatic mode switching.)
  tokens/tokens-data  (Colors for charts and graphs: one categorical accent per series, a neutral for labels and reference lines, and sequential ramps from 5 (darkest) to 1 (lightest) for ordered scales and heatmaps. Import dataVars from @astryxdesign/core/theme/dataTokens.stylex for CSS-capable code. Source compilation emits the complete 56-variable group when any member is retained and none for an unused graph. Prebuilt CSS consumers load @astryxdesign/core/astryx.css, which defines the complete group for the already-compiled dataVars entry.)
  tokens/tokens-syntax  (Code highlighting colors used by CodeBlock. Each defaults to a palette token, so syntax colors follow the theme; defineTheme({syntax}) sets a syntax theme instead.)
  tokens/tokens-spacing  (Spacing scale used for padding, gap, and margin. Component gap props map spacing steps to these tokens.)
  tokens/tokens-size  (Control heights for consistent sizing across buttons, inputs, and selectors.)
  tokens/tokens-border  (Border width for card and input borders.)
  tokens/tokens-focus  (The keyboard focus ring, shared by every component that draws one. Override these to restyle focus across the system.)
  tokens/tokens-radius  (Numeric scale based on a 4dp base unit. Tokens scale with the theme's radius multiplier; --radius-none and --radius-full are fixed.)
  tokens/tokens-shadow  (Elevation shadows (low to med to high) and inset shadows for input state rings.)
  tokens/tokens-duration  (Motion duration primitives. Three bands: fast (micro-interactions), medium (entrance/exit), slow (continuous). Min/max variants derive from base × ratio. Of a theme's two `motion` knobs, `tempo` (0.75–1.5) scales every duration here; `character` leaves durations alone. A duration scale beats `tempo` for the bands it sets, and explicit `tokens` beat both. `tempo` leaves these unscaled: finger tracking, momentum, the rubber band, the on-screen keyboard, the press's onset delay, cancel distance and tap flash, hover-intent delays, gesture thresholds, Spinner's and Skeleton's loops, and the 200 ms Reduce Motion cap.)
  tokens/tokens-ease  (Easing curves for animations and transitions. Of a theme's two `motion` knobs, `character` sets `--ease-entrance` and `--ease-move`: `crisp` decelerates without overshoot, `expressive` overshoots slightly, and at `standard` both equal `--ease-standard`; `--ease-exit` keeps its own curve at every character. `tempo` leaves curves alone. A duration scale's own fields win over the knobs, and explicit `tokens` win over everything. No curve here shapes motion that follows a finger or the system (dragging, momentum, the rubber band, the on-screen keyboard), and the press's clocks, hover-intent delays and gesture thresholds keep their timing whatever the character.)
  tokens/tokens-typography  (Font family stacks for body, code, and heading text.)
  tokens/tokens-text-size  (Geometric type scale: round(14 × 1.2^step). Base is 14px (--font-size-base).)
  tokens/tokens-font-weight  (Font weight values for body, emphasis, and headings.)
  tokens/tokens-type-scale  (Semantic tokens for headings, body, labels, code, supporting text, and display text. References font size and weight tokens. Override via typography.scale in defineTheme.)
  tokens/tokens-usage  (How to import and use token variables in StyleX styles.)
